finish.summary:
**Root cause**: In `packages/workflow/src/tool-helpers.ts`, the `nodeNameToToolName` function truncates a tool name to 64 characters and then runs `toolName.replace(/[_-]+$/, '')` to strip trailing separators left by truncation. When the first 64 characters consist entirely of underscores or hyphens (e.g. `'-'.repeat(64) + 'Suffix'`), the regex removes the entire string, returning `''`.

**Fix**: Before applying the trailing-separator removal, save the stripped result and only overwrite `toolName` if the stripped result is non-empty. If stripping would produce an empty string, the original truncated name (all separators) is kept, guaranteeing a non-empty result.

**Files changed**:
- `packages/workflow/src/tool-helpers.ts` – added a guard `if (stripped.length > 0) { toolName = stripped; }` so the entire name is never wiped.
- `packages/workflow/test/tool-helpers.test.ts` – added 3 new tests covering all-hyphen and all-underscore truncated names, plus a pure-separator long string.

All 25 tests pass (22 existing + 3 new).
finish.risks: Very low. The change only guards the existing regex replacement, preserving existing behavior for all normal cases (where the stripped string is non-empty). The only change is that names composed entirely of separators will keep their full 64-char separator string instead of becoming empty – still a valid tool name (contains only `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`).
